summary.notes: V6 baseline: RFC-019 (span parser, entity resolver, ontology expansion, compositional inference, retrieval plan builder, RFC-018 sensory priors) + RFC-020 (SCR/ELA/SlotF1 measurement framework). Judge N=3 median, CoT+few-shot prompt, NLI atomic claim faithfulness, bootstrap CI, latency SLA, judge floor=0.05. DEFAULT_MAPPINGS 150 phrases. Placeholder hallucination blocked. Bare tool call recovery. finishReason=length truncation recovery. Near-duplicate skipNearDuplicate for parallel batches. ADR-011 PR2 dual-emit: scrInferredGraph / csrInferredGraph added alongside flat values. Wave C 2026-04-15 local measurement: scrInferred/scrInferredGraph populated from an LLM-free offline symbolic extraction run (runConstraintExtraction + ConstraintCompiler, no OpenAI/Vespa/PG), evaluating all 32 scenarios in AGENT_SCENARIOS that carry expectedConstraints, of which 6 declare an inferred-tier expectation. scrInferredGraph improved by +8.33pp over flat scrInferred on the inferred-only subset (0.5 vs 0.4166667), driven by scenario id=30 (comparison_nested, Barolo/Brunello OR-group over grape_primary) where the flat set intersection scored 0.5 but the graph-aware root satisfaction scored 1.0 — exactly the XOR/OR credit case ADR-011 PR2 was written to measure. csrInferred / csrInferredGraph remain null because constraint satisfaction requires agent tool observations, which need the full PG+Redis+Vespa+LLM container that this offline run intentionally avoids; those will populate on the next real-container nightly.

waveCOfflineMeasurement.methodology: LLM-free runConstraintExtraction() over all AGENT_SCENARIOS with expectedConstraints. Symbolic path only (QueryNormalizer + ConstraintCompiler + NLMapper(NO_OP) + Entity Resolver + Ontology Expansion + Reasoner). CONSTRAINT_GRAPH_EMIT default-on → trivial graphs emitted per scenario. csrInferred[Graph] NOT measured (requires observations / full container).

divergentScenarios.query: 바롤로랑 브루넬로 비교해주고, 둘 중 지금 마시기 좋은 거로 골라줘
divergentScenarios.explanation: Two expected inferred grape_primary atoms (Nebbiolo from Barolo, Sangiovese from Brunello). Flat set-intersection credits only the single arm the extractor happens to emit first (0.5). The graph-aware metric recognises the OR grouping over the two appellations and counts the whole group as satisfied once any branch is covered (1.0) — the exact XOR/OR credit case ADR-011 PR2 was designed to measure.

waveCOfflineMeasurement.reproCommand: node_modules/.bin/tsx /tmp/measure-scr-inferred-graph.mts  # LLM-free; writes full JSON to stdout

constraintPipeline.note: tier6 rate는 Tier 1+2가 0 constraint → Tier 6 regex가 단독 extraction한 비율. 'fallback'이 아니라 6-tier cascade의 마지막 tier.
